item.title: Self-Hosted Whistleblowing Platforms: SecureDrop vs GlobaLeaks — Secure Anonymous Reporting Systems
item.description:
Introduction

Whistleblowing platforms provide a secure, anonymous channel for individuals to report wrongdoing, corruption, or misconduct to journalists, watchdog organizations, or internal compliance teams. Unlike consumer messaging apps, these platforms are purpose-built for source protection—they leave no digital traces, resist forensic analysis, and operate over anonymizing networks like Tor.

item.title: Self-Hosted Tor Relay Infrastructure: Tor Relay vs OnionBalance vs Snowflake Proxy
item.description: The Tor network relies on volunteers running relays, bridges, and onion services to provide anonymous communication for millions of users worldwide. Running your own Tor relay infrastructure contributes to a more decentralized and resilient network while giving you direct control over censorship circumvention capabilities. In this guide, we compare three core components of self-hosted Tor infrastructure: the standard Tor relay daemon, OnionBalance for high-availability hidden services, and the Snowflake proxy for WebRTC-based bridge distribution.
